headline: Why do petrol and diesel prices in Spain keep rising despite government discounts? An expert answers
summary: Spanish petrol and diesel prices continue to rise despite government discounts. A commentator attributes the problem to geopolitical factors and a shortage of infrastructure.
why: Fuel prices feed into inflation and household spending, and they reflect global crude and refined product markets.
